definition: the meal you have in the morning
exampleSentence: I usually have breakfast at seven o'clock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thường ăn sáng lúc bảy giờ.

definition: a meal eaten in the late morning, instead of breakfast and lunch
exampleSentence: We met for brunch on Sunday.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gặp nhau ăn brunch vào Chủ nhật.

definition: a meal eaten in the middle of the day
exampleSentence: What's for lunch today?
exampleTranslation: Trưa nay ăn gì vậy?

definition: food such as sandwiches that you take to work or school for lunch
translation: cơm trưa mang theo, bữa trưa mang theo
exampleSentence: I take a packed lunch to work every day.
exampleTranslation: Ngày nào tôi cũng mang cơm trưa đi làm.

definition: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening
exampleSentence: We are having fish for dinner tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay chúng tôi ăn cá.

definition: the meal you have in the early evening
exampleSentence: Why don't you come over for supper on Friday?
exampleTranslation: Thứ Sáu bạn qua nhà chúng tôi ăn tối nhé?

definition: an occasion when you eat food, or the food you eat then
exampleSentence: We must have a meal together some time.
exampleTranslation: Lúc nào đó chúng ta phải cùng ăn một bữa nhé.

definition: a small amount of food eaten between meals
translation: bữa ăn nhẹ, đồ ăn vặt
exampleSentence: I grabbed a quick snack on the way home.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn vội chút đồ ăn nhẹ trên đường về nhà.

definition: a meal you take with you and eat outdoors
translation: buổi dã ngoại, bữa ăn ngoài trời
exampleSentence: Let's go on a picnic today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay mình đi dã ngoại nhé.

definition: a meal or party where food is cooked over a fire outdoors
exampleSentence: We had a barbecue on the beach.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi tổ chức tiệc nướng trên bãi biển.

definition: a meal where people serve themselves from a table
translation: tiệc buffet, bữa ăn tự chọn
exampleSentence: The price includes a buffet lunch.
exampleTranslation: Giá đã bao gồm bữa trưa buffet.

definition: a meal you buy at a restaurant and eat at home
translation: đồ ăn mang về, bữa ăn mang đi
exampleSentence: Let's have a takeaway tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay mình gọi đồ ăn mang về nhé.

definition: food that has not been eaten at the end of a meal
translation: đồ ăn thừa, thức ăn thừa
exampleSentence: Give the leftovers to the dog.
exampleTranslation: Cho con chó ăn đồ ăn thừa đi.

definition: a meal that is already cooked and sold ready to eat
translation: bữa ăn làm sẵn, đồ ăn đóng gói sẵn
exampleSentence: I was tired, so I bought a ready meal.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mệt nên mua một bữa ăn làm sẵn.

definition: food like hamburgers that is made quickly and can be taken away
exampleSentence: Fast food is quick, but it is not very healthy.
exampleTranslation: Đồ ăn nhanh thì nhanh, nhưng không tốt cho sức khỏe lắm.

definition: one of the separate parts of a meal
exampleSentence: We had fish for the main course.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn cá cho món chính.

definition: a small amount of food eaten at the start of a meal
exampleSentence: We had soup as a starter, followed by steak.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn súp làm món khai vị, sau đó là bít tết.

definition: a small dish that you eat at the beginning of a meal
exampleSentence: We shared an appetizer before the main course.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chia nhau một món khai vị trước món chính.

definition: the main part of a meal
exampleSentence: What are you going to have for your main course?
exampleTranslation: Bạn sẽ ăn món chính là gì?

definition: a small amount of food eaten with the main part of a meal
exampleSentence: I ordered a side dish of vegetables.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gọi thêm một món rau ăn kèm.

definition: sweet food served after the main part of a meal
exampleSentence: What are we having for dessert?
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta ăn gì tráng miệng vậy?

definition: an amount of food for one person, especially in a restaurant
exampleSentence: The portions are very big in this restaurant.
exampleTranslation: Suất ăn ở nhà hàng này rất lớn.

definition: cooked liquid food, often with pieces of meat or vegetables
exampleSentence: I'd like a bowl of tomato soup, please.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một bát súp cà chua.

definition: two pieces of bread with cheese, meat or egg between them
exampleSentence: I made a ham sandwich for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Tôi làm một cái bánh mì kẹp giăm bông cho bữa trưa.

definition: a flat round piece of cooked beef, often served in a bread bun
translation: bánh hamburger, bánh mì kẹp thịt
exampleSentence: I'll have a burger and a cold drink.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một cái hamburger và một ly nước lạnh.

definition: a flat round bread baked with tomato, cheese and other food on top
exampleSentence: Would you like a slice of pizza?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn một miếng pizza không?

definition: an Italian food made from flour, eggs and water, usually eaten with a sauce
exampleSentence: I eat a lot of pasta.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn rất nhiều mì Ý.

definition: a type of pasta in very long thin pieces
exampleSentence: For supper we had spaghetti.
exampleTranslation: Bữa tối chúng tôi ăn mì Ý.

definition: an Italian food made with flat pasta, meat or vegetables, and cheese
exampleSentence: I made a big lasagne for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi làm một khay lasagna lớn cho bữa tối.

definition: long thin pieces of food made from flour, water and eggs, cooked in soup or boiling water
exampleSentence: Serve the meat with rice or noodles.
exampleTranslation: Dọn thịt ăn kèm cơm hoặc mì.

definition: small white or brown grains that you boil in water and eat
exampleSentence: I'd like a plate of rice, please.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một đĩa cơm.

definition: a Japanese dish of small cakes of cooked rice with raw fish
exampleSentence: Let's order some sushi tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay mình gọi sushi nhé.

definition: a dish of meat or vegetables in a spicy sauce
exampleSentence: I think I'll have a chicken curry.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nghĩ tôi sẽ gọi món cà ri gà.

definition: a hot meal of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid
exampleSentence: We had beef stew for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn món bò hầm cho bữa tối.

definition: thin rolled pastry filled with vegetables or meat and cooked in oil
exampleSentence: We shared a plate of spring rolls.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chia nhau một đĩa chả giò.

definition: a Mexican food made of a folded corn pancake filled with meat or beans
exampleSentence: We made tacos for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi làm bánh taco cho bữa tối.

definition: small pieces of meat and vegetables cooked on a stick
exampleSentence: We ate chicken kebabs at the market.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn thịt gà nướng xiên ở chợ.

definition: chicken cooked in hot oil
exampleSentence: They filled their plates with fried chicken.
exampleTranslation: Họ xếp đầy đĩa gà rán.

definition: chicken cooked in an oven
exampleSentence: For dinner we're having roast chicken.
exampleTranslation: Bữa tối chúng tôi ăn gà nướng.

definition: a meal of fried fish with fried pieces of potato
translation: cá chiên và khoai tây chiên
exampleSentence: Get some fish and chips on your way home.
exampleTranslation: Trên đường về, bạn mua ít cá và khoai tây chiên nhé.

definition: long thin pieces of potato cooked in oil (British English)
exampleSentence: I had steak and chips for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn bít tết và khoai tây chiên vào bữa tối.

definition: long thin pieces of potato cooked in hot oil
exampleSentence: I'd like a burger and French fries.
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một cái hamburger và khoai tây chiên.

definition: potatoes boiled and crushed until smooth
exampleSentence: I like sausages with mashed potatoes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích xúc xích ăn kèm khoai tây nghiền.

definition: a potato cooked in its skin in an oven
exampleSentence: I'd like a baked potato with cheese.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn một củ khoai tây nướng phô mai.

definition: fruit, meat or vegetables baked inside a pastry covering
exampleSentence: Would you like another piece of apple pie?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn thêm một miếng bánh táo nữa không?

definition: a thin flat round cake cooked in a pan and eaten hot
exampleSentence: I had pancakes with honey for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn bánh kếp với mật ong vào bữa sáng.

definition: a food made from flour and water that is baked
exampleSentence: Would you like some bread with your soup?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn ăn bánh mì với súp không?

definition: bread that has been heated until it is brown and crisp
exampleSentence: I had a piece of toast for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn một lát bánh mì nướng vào bữa sáng.

definition: a small round loaf of bread for one person
translation: ổ bánh mì nhỏ, bánh mì tròn nhỏ
exampleSentence: I had a cheese roll for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn một ổ bánh mì phô mai vào bữa trưa.

definition: a small round type of bread
exampleSentence: I put the burger in a bun.
exampleTranslation: Tôi kẹp miếng thịt vào bánh mì tròn.

definition: a long thin loaf of bread, made especially in France
translation: bánh mì baguette, bánh mì Pháp
exampleSentence: I bought a fresh baguette this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay tôi mua một ổ bánh mì baguette mới.

definition: a breakfast food made from grain, usually eaten with milk
exampleSentence: I eat a bowl of cereal every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng ăn một bát ngũ cốc.

definition: oats cooked with milk or water and served hot for breakfast
exampleSentence: I often have porridge for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thường ăn cháo yến mạch vào bữa sáng.

definition: a thick cooked liquid served with food to give it taste
exampleSentence: Do you want tomato sauce on your pasta?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn thêm sốt cà chua lên mì không?

definition: a list of the food you can order in a restaurant
exampleSentence: Could we have the menu, please?
exampleTranslation: Cho chúng tôi xem thực đơn nhé.

definition: to ask for food or a drink in a restaurant
translation: gọi món, gọi (đồ ăn, thức uống)
exampleSentence: Are you ready to order?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đã sẵn sàng gọi món chưa?

definition: to give someone food or drink, especially in a restaurant
exampleSentence: They serve breakfast until ten o'clock.
exampleTranslation: Họ phục vụ bữa sáng đến mười giờ.

definition: a man who serves food and drink at tables in a restaurant
translation: người phục vụ nam, bồi bàn
exampleSentence: The waiter brought us the menu.
exampleTranslation: Người phục vụ mang thực đơn đến cho chúng tôi.

definition: a woman who serves food and drink at tables in a restaurant
translation: nữ phục vụ bàn, cô bồi bàn
exampleSentence: The waitress brought our soup.
exampleTranslation: Nhân viên phục vụ mang súp đến cho chúng tôi.

definition: a skilled cook, especially the main cook in a restaurant
exampleSentence: The chef made a wonderful pasta dish.
exampleTranslation: Đầu bếp đã làm một món mì Ý tuyệt vời.

definition: a list showing how much you must pay for food in a restaurant
exampleSentence: Could we have the bill, please?
exampleTranslation: Cho chúng tôi xin hóa đơn.

definition: a small extra amount of money you give to a waiter
exampleSentence: Did you leave a tip for the waiter?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có để lại tiền boa cho người phục vụ không?

definition: someone who eats no animal products, such as meat, eggs or milk
exampleSentence: I am a vegan, so I don't eat eggs or milk.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn thuần chay nên không ăn trứng hay sữa.

definition: the kind of food that a person eats each day
translation: chế độ ăn, khẩu phần ăn
exampleSentence: A healthy diet includes lots of fruit and vegetables.
exampleTranslation: Một chế độ ăn lành mạnh có nhiều trái cây và rau.
